# MIOSA CLI 1.1.17

## Added

- Added an explicit `--static` deploy mode that omits build and run commands for static sites.

## Fixed

- `miosa deploy --docker-deploy` is now automation-safe: JSON mode and non-TTY stdin never open interactive prompts.
- Unknown project shapes now fail before reaching the API and require explicit `--build-command` and `--run-command` instead of guessing.
- Creation flags (`--name`, `--branch`, `--build-command`, `--run-command`, `--static`) passed when `.miosa.json` already exists are now an error, so automation never silently redeploys a different configuration.
